info.name: Appen Platform Account Info Workflow Step Routes API
View the list of routes associated with a Step.

params.name: workflow_id
params.description: The `id` of a **Workflow** belonging to the **Requestor** or accessible to the **Admin**.

items.docs:
List routes for a Workflow Step. \
Note that one workflow step can route to __multiple__ destination steps _(or the same step with different filter rules)_ by creating multiple StepRoutes

params.name: workflow_id
params.description: The `id` of a **Workflow** belonging to the **Requestor** or accessible to the **Admin**.

items.docs:
Create a configuration object for routing data coming out of the data processor in the step specified by `workflow_step_id` to the step specified by `destination_step_id`.
Think of `workflow_step` and `destination_step` as _nodes_ in the Workflow's configuration 'graph' and this route as the _edge_ between them.

info.name: Change route destination and filter rules.

params.description: The `id` of a **Workflow** belonging to the **Requestor** or accessible to the **Admin**.

items.docs: Update a step route by changing the destination step Think of `workflow_step` and `destination_step` as _nodes_ in the Workflow's configuration 'graph' and this route as the _edge_ between them.

info.name: Delete a route associated with a Step.
